description: The Verdict type select keeps 'Independent check' after a verdict is submitted, so the next Accept/Reject is silently recorded as another independent check unless the person notices and switches back. Only the latest verdict of each kind is shown, and evidence is never displayed, so an accidental overwrite is hard to notice.
expected: Two separate, labelled actions ('Record independent check' and 'Human verdict: Accept / Reject'), or a select that resets to Human acceptance after submit.
actual: A sticky select that changes the meaning of the same Accept/Reject buttons.
suggested_fix: Split the form into two sections, one per verdict kind, each with its own buttons and the latest evidence shown.

description: Only the latest verdict per kind is shown. A later acceptance replaces an earlier rejection on screen, and verdict evidence is never rendered, so the review trail ('rejected: lacks jitter' → 'accepted: jitter added') cannot be seen in the UI.
expected: A verdict history list with actor, decision, evidence and time.
actual: A single line per kind, without evidence.
suggested_fix: Render all verdicts (as CloudControl does) with their evidence, newest first, and collapse older ones.

description: The Record artifact field is free text in a 'kind value' format. The allowed kinds (commit, branch, pull_request, test_result, note) appear only in the error after a failed attempt, the placeholder shows only 'commit abc1234', and the field label and button are both 'Record artifact'. Recorded artifacts show a raw snake_case kind, and a PR reference is not a link.
expected: A Kind select plus a Value field, a distinct field label ('Artifact'), and PR/commit values linked to GitHub.
actual: Users discover the format by trial and error.
suggested_fix: Split the field into kind and value, label kinds in plain words, and link owner/repo#N and commit hashes.
